scoring_justification: B_2D is recomputed from the raw force–strain curve by a zero-intercept linear fit on small-strain points (T1). B_eff and γ_G are compared to paper-reported values because they are derived quantities that cannot be recomputed from the curve without the agent’s post-processing; the T0 comparison to gold is sufficient as the load-bearing check.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for 2D bulk modulus, effective 3D bulk modulus, and Grüneisen parameter.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper's main text: B_2D ≈ 200 N/m, B_eff ≈ 600 GPa, γ_G ≈ 2.1 (see Fig. 5 and associated discussion).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly taken from the paper's reported MD simulation results.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact quantities the reproduction task targets; they are the paper's headline numerical outputs from the simulation.

outputs.description: Raw force per unit length vs relative surface change data; the checker will fit the linear small-strain region to recompute the 2D bulk modulus.
Reported 2D bulk modulus, effective 3D bulk modulus, and Grüneisen parameter derived from the simulation.

output_contract.notes: The checker will internally recompute B_2D from the force_surface_curve.csv linear fit and verify it against the paper's reported value, and will also read md_results_summary.json to compare all three quantities to reference values with hidden tolerances.

steps.description: Recompute B_2D by linear least-squares fit (zero intercept) on points with |delta_SR| <= 0.01, compare to target 200 N/m with absolute tolerance 10 N/m.
Compare reported effective 3D bulk modulus against target 600 GPa with absolute tolerance 30 GPa.
Compare reported Grüneisen parameter against target 2.1 with absolute tolerance 0.2.
